summary: Organon & Co. filed an 8-K disclosing litigation related to its pending acquisition by Sun Pharma USA. Under the April 26, 2026 Merger Agreement, Merger Sub will merge with Organon, which will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary. A July 6 complaint alleges inadequate proxy disclosures and seeks to enjoin the July 23 special meeting vote. Organon, voluntarily supplementing disclosures without admitting liability, denies merit. The deal terms (price per share, premium, etc.) were not provided in this filing. The court's ruling on the preliminary injunction and shareholder vote outcome are key to closing; any delay could create an arbitrage opportunity.
